investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Skyeron Software (collaboration SaaS); Platform: on-premises data center DC-B, server range 10.9.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster skyero-prod (kubeadm); Bare-metal Kubernetes workers; IPMI SEL and EDAC kernel messages are forwarded to Elasticsearch; data-center work uses DC- identifiers; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
